title: The Work page and a work item page share one page shell, lead with their fact and action, use the width and never scroll sideways
description: A real browser at 1440 px and at 390 px signs in to a real control plane serving the built dashboard, with seeded items. The Work page and a work item page put the same title element in the same page heading, the same section heading style and the same card class; any table carries the one table class. The first screen shows the page title, its primary fact and its primary action without scrolling; at 1440 px the content spans at least 85 percent of the width beside the sidebar; at 390 px the page never scrolls sideways; and no console error is logged.

steps.name: walk the Work page and an item page at 1440 px and 390 px
